message: XVatsim 2.1.0 is available with the new Manager and xPilot 4 companion. Download the freeware Windows XP12 package from X-Plane.org or GitHub Releases.
release_notes: Adds the XVatsim Manager for guided install, update, repair, SHA-256 verification, and automatic rollback.
Adds a read-only xPilot 4 SDK companion while preserving the proven xPilot 3 integration and Brain-only decision ownership.
Recovers retained xPilot 4 PDC/ACARS information at startup and wraps long Drawer messages without clipping.
Improves stale or unknown METAR flight-rule classification and keeps received-age text current.
